items.title: Intraday Technical Analysis of Individual Stocks on the Tokyo Stock Exchange
items.abstract: <jats:p>This paper conducts an intraday technical analysis of individual stocks listed on the Nikkei 225. In addition to the price-based technical rules popularly examined in the literature, we propose and statistically investigate technical rules that utilize information regarding 1) the order-flow imbalance and 2) the order-book imbalance. Such rules have not been developed and investigated by previous studies on technical analysis. items.title: Currency Orders and Exchange-Rate Dynamics: Explaining the Success of Technical Analysis
items.abstract:
<jats:p>This paper provides a microstructural explanation for the success of two familiar predictions from technical analysis: 1) trends tend to be reversed at predictable support and resistance levels, and 2) trends gain momentum once predictable support and resistance levels are crossed. 

The explanation is based on a close examination of stop-loss and take-profit orders at a large foreign exchange dealing bank.
